source.title: Northern Whig, 9 May 1908, p. 10 ("Newry No. 2": withdrawals and "the construction of the Council")
source.publisher: Northern Whig (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: every name read from the page image; "there will therefore be no District Council contests", no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council, 1908: after withdrawals there were no contests. No party labels are printed. Returned unopposed. Thomas J. Hale withdrew; he and Monaghan, the retiring councillors, were the only nominees, so a casual vacancy was left to be filled by co-option.
